decision.reason: [ev-61a7d576a759] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that an opt-in AND operator option was added for sync window matches. It doesn't name the field, key or flag that turns the option on, so the subject can't be written as a typed assertion. Without that, applicability can't be expressed as an exposure condition either. We need the PR #16846 diff, the sync windows documentation, or a CRD schema diff showing the new option's name and path.
